items.question: Do I need to know which artist I want?
items.answer: No. Tell Bharat about your event and he will talk through suitable options with you.

items.question: Do I need a date or a budget before getting in touch?
items.answer: No. A short description of what you are planning is enough to start the conversation.

items.question: What kinds of events does Bharat work on?
items.answer: Celebrity appearances, live entertainment and cultural events, from community celebrations and festivals to events for organisations and brands.

items.question: What happens after I get in touch?
items.answer: You share your event, discuss the options that would suit it, and agree the next steps together.

items.question: What is the best way to reach him?
items.answer: Email is the quickest. You can also send a message on Instagram or Facebook, or use the short form on this page.
